name: ActiveCampaign
category_description: App node - connects to an external service API
description: Use the ActiveCampaign node to automate work in ActiveCampaign, and integrate ActiveCampaign with other applications. n8n has built-in support for a wide range of ActiveCampaign features, including creating, getting, updating, and deleting accounts, contact, orders, e-commerce customers, connections, lists, tags, and deals
